checks.name: Full catalog search reaches description beyond the first loaded page
Category OR and cross-dimension AND produce the intended identities
Facet counts exclude their own dimension and respect the others
Unknown price is distinct from zero and remains last in both price orders
Unknown availability remains distinct from unavailable
Newest order uses valid dates and leaves the unknown date last
Paging is complete stable and duplicate-free
Cursor is rejected for a changed search or facet selection
Content edits invalidate old cursors even when declared version is unchanged
Expanded catalog pages beyond the original eighteen without a fixed cap
Malformed oversized and out-of-range cursor and page inputs fail explicitly
Search is normalized Unicode text and not an executable expression
URL roundtrip retains filters ordering expanded position and reading identity
Invalid link filters have a problem state rather than a fake empty result
Malformed identities price styles dates duplicates and stock values are rejected
Catalog size is bounded and parsing does not retain caller-owned records
Aborted async query never returns stale results
Failed query can retry while a true empty result remains a confirmed zero

limitations: Original fictional catalog and local adapter; no real store stock, commerce or large-catalog performance acceptance
Client continuation token is a demo cursor, not an authorization token
